notes.title: Greetings everyone!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!
2xP Games are thrilled to announce that Fishing for Numbers, is coming to Steam. 

Fishing for Numbers is a vibrant, first-person educational adventure where you step into the shoes of an aspiring wizard on a quest to join the prestigious Arcane Anglers Guild. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438972/cfdc4c78f6b02724bf0d0b2a0e076f2e7a2d2cdf.png"]
Entertaining and educational!
Master increasingly harder equations and catch magical fish to prove your worth and earn your place among the elite! Specialize in addition, subtraction, multiplication or division, or become a master of them all! Unlock the secrets of the guild by catching larger fish, thus unlocking new features and challenges.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438972/bdcec366cf1b9d3d20d7edfb502c09eb39cb5243.png"]
Upcoming!
The demo will be available 26th September and the game enters Early Access in 2025 Q4. Expected full release 2026 Q4. More details coming soon!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438972/ff835163d25bd572788663a2de0a34045851c27d.png"]


Wishlist the game on Steam!
